title: Automated powder dosing with a Quantos and automated dissolution of the dose
summary: An automated platform doses solid into tared vials with a modified Mettler Toledo Quantos, then a robot arm moves the vial to a stirring station where solvent is added in small increments until the solid dissolves. Shows the hand-offs and per-sample time scale of powder dosing as a library-prep bottleneck.

steps.text: Load solids into Quantos dosing heads once; after that no manual intervention.
Robot arm picks a clean vial, uncaps it and positions it in the Quantos.
Quantos tares the balance and doses the target mass of solid.
Arm lifts the vial out, recaps it with torque feedback and moves it to the stir station.
Syringe pump adds an initial solvent volume and stirring starts.
Add further solvent in 10-30 uL increments, checking each time whether the solid has dissolved, until clear.

duration_s.note: Source: 20-80 min per solvent system; midpoint rounded.

safety: Dust control when dosing solids; ventilated enclosure for solvents.
notes: Source is a solubility screen, so the steps adapt to building-block stock prep; the dissolution check loop would be replaced by a fixed volume in a library workflow. Quantos dose time itself is not given.
